newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland plans to list potato processor.
newsitem.headline: Poland plans to list potato processor.

text.p: National Investment Fund (NFI) No. 3 in Poland's mass privatisation programme plans to put potato processor Przedsiebiorstwo Przemyslu Spozywczego PEPEES SA on the Warsaw bourse next year, a fund official said on Friday.
"The intention of the fund is to put PEPEES on the bourse next year," Michal Jankowski, vice director for firms in which the fund has a controlling stake, told Reuters.
Jankowski said the fund had yet to decide on which bourse floor it would float PEPEES.

He said the firm would not issue more shares but would put 1.17 million already-issued shares into public trade and that on October 25 shareholders would decide whether to raise the share capital to 7.02 million zlotys by transferring shares from reserve capital.
The firm, based in the northeastern town of Lomza, currently has a share capital of 2.48 million zlotys.
From October 1, 1994 to the end of last year PEPEES made a net profit of 5.64 million zlotys on 132.3 million in sales. @
NFI No. 3 holds 33 percent of the firm's shares, employees and suppliers hold 30 percent, the other 14 funds in the NFI scheme have 27 percent, and the state treasury has 10 percent.
